parsed_documents.title: About Microsoft — Company Overview
parsed_documents.text:
Company Overview

Microsoft Corporation
Microsoft Corporation is a multinational technology company incorporated under the laws of the State of Washington, United States.

Corporate Headquarters
The Company's principal executive offices are located at One Microsoft Way, Redmond, Washington 98052, USA. The registered jurisdiction of incorporation is the State of Washington, United States of America. All material legal and regulatory correspondence is directed to the Redmond, WA headquarters.

Products and Services
Microsoft develops, manufactures, licenses, and supports a broad range of software products and services for various types of computing devices. Major product categories include Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing.

Revenue and Financial Highlights
For the fiscal year ended June 30, 2024, Microsoft reported total revenue of $245.1 billion USD. Operating income was $109.4 billion USD. The company employs approximately 228,000 full-time employees worldwide.

Environmental and Sustainability
Microsoft has committed to being carbon negative by 2030. The company's principal sustainability operations are managed from Redmond, Washington, United States.

Contact Information
Investor Relations: One Microsoft Way, Redmond, WA 98052-6399, United States.
